solution_summary: As regulatory requirements evolved and customer expectations increased, the company embarked on a broad digital transformation to improve operational efficiency, strengthen customer experience, and enable faster, more informed decision-making across the business. To support this transformation, Sabesp modernized its legacy Oracle Exadata-based data warehouse and adopted Databricks as the foundation for its data and AI strategy. Today, Databricks powers a Data Mesh architecture spanning more than 23 business domains, supports large-scale SAP data ingestion, and enables self-service analytics and AI-driven applications across the organization. For Sabesp, data became a strategic asset in navigating this transformation.

Sabesp (Companhia de Saneamento Básico do Estado de São Paulo) supplies drinking water and provides wastewater collection and treatment across 376 municipalities in the state of São Paulo serving around 30 million people.
Sabesp aims to leap five decades in five years, expanding access to safe water and sanitation for millions.

As regulatory requirements evolved and customer expectations increased, the company embarked on a broad digital transformation to improve operational efficiency, strengthen customer experience, and enable faster, more informed decision-making across the business.
The water and sanitation industry in Brazil is undergoing significant change.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL

solution_components.name: Genie
solution_components.role: Lets nontechnical teams at Sabesp query governed data in natural language.

solution_components.name: AI/BI
